title: Did you know? We program Niagara stations
text: Need logic changed, trends set up, alarms routed or graphics built? Our engineers do Niagara 4 programming and integration at a fair price.

title: Did you know? Low-cost preventive maintenance
text: A scheduled check of your Niagara system catches clock drift, dead trends and nuisance alarms before they cost you. Ask about our preventive maintenance plans.

title: Tip: ask in your own words
text: Try "check out floor 2, any outstanding issues?" or "did AHU-3 shut off last night?". Tell it when something is on purpose and it will remember.
